text:
Leila_CS: Quick sync — NimbusCommerce reserved pool go-live next Tue. I uploaded a short 'surge cookbook' with run order, fallback plays, and quota split suggestions. Need sign-off on autoscale tuning + region quota. @Marco_SRE @Priya_Eng please jump in. TL;DR: target steady QPS ~1.2k, burst up to ~4k for 5m, reserved GPUs 48(us-west) + 12(eu-west).
Marco_SRE: Looking. Early thought: autoscale targets should be queue latency <200ms and GPU util ceiling 85%. Keep burst headroom ~20% for transient queues. Also recommend tracking pending requests metric.
Priya_Eng: Agree with 200ms target. Suggest KV cache priming TTL = 12h and a warmup sequence: run 10% of prod token distribution for 24h pre-cutover. That helps KV hit-rate before traffic shift.
Leila_CS: Got it. I added a smoke test block — staging 30-min soak tomorrow 10:00 PDT. Ops_Oncall / Tom_Nimbus, confirm customer side engineer on-call for the window.
Tom_Nimbus: Confirmed — Sam from Nimbus will be on the call and reachable. One ask from them: assurance on renewal if perf issues occur in week-1. CSM flagged potential discount ask.
Ava_PM: Noted. Renewal risk flagged: if 95th latency >400ms after go-live they requested a commercial remediation. Let's avoid that by being strict on thresholds and rollback criteria.
deploy-bot: deploy-bot: scheduled loadtest job #45678 for nimbus-staging at 2026-03-25T17:00Z (k6 run).
Marco_SRE: Load test recipe — use k6 with variable arrival rates and payload sizes. Example command/snippet: ```
k6 run --vus 200 --duration 30m loadtest.js
// loadtest.js: vary prompt sizes (short/medium/long), pin model ref v1.2.3, record latency, gpu_util, pending_requests
```
Priya_Eng: Add shadow traffic plan: route 1%->5% of prod to dedicated pool over 10m ramp, hold 1h at 5%, then regress. Capture distribution by prompt size to check cache warmup.
Leila_CS: Operation plan: 1) staging soak (tomorrow), 2) shadow traffic on prod (Wed 15:00 UTC), 3) full cutover if stable + 12h observation. Rollback: shift routing back to hosted region and drain pool. Checklist in section 3 of the cookbook.
Ops_Oncall: Acknowledged. I'll run the checklist and monitor autoscale events, GPU queue, and KV hit-rate. Where's the checklist link?
Leila_CS: Checklist is in the doc I uploaded (section 3). Quick paste of critical checks: - verify reserved pool slot counts - run sample prompts to prime KV - validate autoscale thresholds (queue latency & gpu_util) - ensure fallback routing policy enabled - confirm logs stream to console retention 72h.
Tom_Nimbus: Nimbus confirms Sam + infra lead Priya will be on standby for the shadow run. We'll capture feedback in this thread during the dry run.
Ava_PM: I'll consolidate customer feedback into the enablement form and share a one-pager by Thu EOD. Also will note any commercial mitigation if SLA breach surfaces.
Leila_CS: Owners: Marco_SRE -> autoscale tuning and loadtest metrics, Priya_Eng -> warmup scripts & priming, Ava_PM -> renewal/runbook signoff & enablement notes, Ops_Oncall -> smoke/soak monitoring, Tom_Nimbus -> customer contact. Thanks everyone :thumbsup:
Marco_SRE: Quick follow — recommend we set an alert: pending_requests > 150 for 2m -> paging, and 95th latency >300ms -> pager after confirmation.
Priya_Eng: I'll push the warmup script to the cookbook repo after the staging soak and include token distribution stats.
Leila_CS: Perfect. Final ask: please react with :white_check_mark: when you own your item so I can close the checklist.
Tom_Nimbus: White_check_mark from our side.
Ops_Oncall: :white_check_mark:
Marco_SRE: :white_check_mark:
Priya_Eng: :white_check_mark:
Ava_PM: :white_check_mark:
